newsitem.title: USA: Chief Auto Parts files with SEC for note offer.
newsitem.headline: Chief Auto Parts files with SEC for note offer.

text.p: Chief Auto Parts Inc filed on Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of $125 million of senior notes due 2005.

The Dallas-based auto parts and accessories retail chain said proceeds from the sale will be used to repay outstanding debt under its existing credit facility, pay certain employees $4 million in previously accrued incentive compensation and distribute about $65 million to stockholders.
Credit Suisse First Boston and Salomon Brothers will underwrite the offering, it said.
